reviewer: hard_overnight independent source/stdlib-regex static peer; no app imports, Qt or owning runtime tests
decision: REQUEST ONE NARROW CORRECTION before apply: avoid applying ANSI regex twice to visible text; retain CR carry algorithm.
positive_findings: Only trailing visible CR is carried; preceding CR in repeated CR sequence is normalized as an already-complete loneCR.
Complete supported ANSI must be removed before deciding whether a visible CR is trailing; ANSI-only and incomplete-ANSI reads therefore correctly retain pendingCR.
LF continuation joins pendingCR into one newline, nonLF resumes existing standaloneCR newline policy, readerclosure flushes pendingCR once.
Stateless strip_terminal_codes/find_urls fullAST unchanged; no public prose/signature/helper/timer/caption change.

blocking_finding.issue: New _ANSI.sub strips text before passing it to strip_terminal_codes, which performs _ANSI.sub again. Regex deletion is not idempotent on all previously accepted strings, so unrelated nested/malformed escapes can consume bytes differently.
blocking_finding.scope: Pure stdlib regex evaluation of exact source literal, not Qt/PtySession/model execution. Counterexample outside well-formed supported escape grammar but existing public stateless semantics are still a finite compatibility contract.
blocking_finding.suggested_fix:

limits: No actual PtySession/Qt or stream-owning tests executed; CI retains its baseline/after acceptance responsibility.

If root explicitly limits stream-equivalence to well-formed terminal escapes, CR carry itself is approved; suggested single-pass normalization still preserves broader compatibility at one return-line change.
